# KabuForge

> KabuForge is an open-source, local-first research framework for Japanese equities.

## Current release

- Latest stable release: [v0.1.1](https://github.com/Siyuan-chat/KabuForge/releases/tag/v0.1.1), package version 0.1.1; Python 3.12+.
- Official website: <https://kabuforge.com/>.
- Source repository: <https://github.com/Siyuan-chat/KabuForge>.
- Current project-owned source, documentation, and original assets use AGPL-3.0-only. Retained notices and third-party terms remain applicable. The historical v0.1.0 release retains its original RC artifacts and MIT terms.

## Product and documentation

- [Documentation overview](https://kabuforge.com/docs/) describes the framework, audience, interfaces, pipeline, and limits.
- [Architecture](https://kabuforge.com/docs/architecture/) documents Factor → Strategy → TargetPortfolio → Risk → Planner → OrderIntent.
- [Quickstart](https://kabuforge.com/docs/quickstart/) installs the stable release and runs the offline demo.
- [Research methodology](https://kabuforge.com/docs/methodology/) explains availability-time checks and their limits.
- [MCP guide](https://kabuforge.com/docs/mcp/) describes workspace-bounded access tiers and local paper opt-in.
- [Offline demo](https://kabuforge.com/examples/offline-demo/) explains the synthetic, reproducible software simulation.
- [Release history](https://kabuforge.com/releases/) distinguishes the current stable release from retained historical artifacts.

## Operating boundaries

- Historical backtesting and paper workflows run as local simulations. Simulated fills are not broker fills; real broker order submission is disabled in v0.1.1.
- The synthetic offline demo uses fictional inputs and needs no market-data API key or broker account. External data providers may have separate credential and licensing requirements.
- Point-in-time checks compare declared `available_at` values with an explicit decision time. They do not certify complete historical PIT coverage, vendor timing, revisions, survivorship treatment, or investment performance.
- Factor diagnostics and synthetic examples do not establish out-of-sample performance, investability, or future returns.

## Research context

- Research notes and project context: [ArcaViso](https://arcaviso.com/).
